sports.title: Sports
sports.description: Pinnacle sport names, e.g. Soccer, Basketball, Football, Baseball, Hockey, Tennis, E Sports, Mixed Martial Arts, Boxing, Golf, Cricket. Empty for every sport with open games.

leagues.title: Leagues
leagues.description: Keep leagues whose name contains one of these, e.g. NFL, NBA, Premier League, Champions League, ATP. Empty for every league in the sports above.

includeTeamTotals.title: Team totals
includeTeamTotals.description: Also each team's own points/goals over-under.

includePeriods.title: Periods (halves, quarters)
includePeriods.description: Also first-half and other period markets, where Pinnacle prices them.

includeAlternateLines.title: Alternate lines
includeAlternateLines.description: Also alternate spreads and totals. Off returns the main line only.

hoursAhead.title: Starting within (hours)
hoursAhead.description: Only games starting in the next N hours. 0 for all upcoming.

onlyChanged.title: Only games whose odds moved
onlyChanged.description: On: return only games that are new or whose prices or lines changed since the last run with the same settings. For line-movement alerts on a schedule; unchanged games are not charged.
